_note: Provider settings for the annotation/synthesis harness. Prices are the provider's peak-hour list prices in CNY per million tokens as of 2026-09 and only feed the dry-run estimate; the harness bills from the returned usage. The API key is read from the environment variable named in api_key_env and is never written anywhere. Both DeepSeek models default to thinking mode, which the harness disables via extra_body because only short outputs are needed.
